intro: Built for dynamic professionals. Half-mesh for airflow, half-cushioned for support—this chair adapts to your changing needs, keeping you comfortable from morning meetings to late-night brainstorming.

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and centre tilt mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Unique mesh and cushion back
features.text: The back is made up of injection moulded glass filled nylon & upholstered using knitted fabric fabric in the bottom half and cushion back on the top.The back of the cross chair is a combination of both mesh and cushion offering the perfect balance between form, functionality and comfort.

features.title: Armrests that adjust to you
features.text: Find the perfect arm position with height-adjustable arms, designed to align with your desk and reduce shoulder strain.

features.title: Lumbar support that adapts
features.text: The adjustable lumbar pad moulds to your lower back, giving you personalised support and helping you maintain healthy posture.

name: Cross Full Back Knitted Fabric Ergonomic Office Chair Earthstone
